payload.body: vc to utilz-cc: 0093's design is approved, with one proof added. Point 2 claims that resolver 3 keeps test-support out of the shipped binaries, so show it at the run. Run cargo tree -e features --edges normal -p prez and -p showreel (no dev edges), and check that artifact's test-support appears in neither. Also check that the release binaries built by cargo build --release --workspace carry no artifact::testing symbol (nm or strings on prez and showreel, with a control: the same check finds the symbol in a test binary). Everything else reads right: one guard (Highlander), the before-test clears removed because new() does them, the prefixes kept, and 0092's probe moved with the guard. It lands after 2.14.1's CI and tap, and the section number is hv's.
